definition: עֲלִיל apparently noun [masculine] , only ׳ כֶּסֶף צָרוּף בַּע לָאָרֶץ Ps 12:7 , usually (after ᵑ7 כּוּרָא ) furnace, crucible ( Hup from III. עלל ; De and others workshop , from I. עלל ) but wholly dubious; Late Hebrew openly Levy NHWB iii. 654 ; Che Du strike out as gloss; compare discussion Che Expos. T. viii. 236, 336 Ne ib. 287, 379 .
